newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana share index rises but ends week lower.
newsitem.headline: Ghana share index rises but ends week lower.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange's All-Share Index rallied on Friday after a heavy mid-week tumble but ended the week slightly lower, its market report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index rose 2.75 points to 357.29 after falling 3.67 points on Wednesday to close at 354.54.
A total of 2,354,300 shares changed hands, up on Wednesday's 148,040 shares. Pioneer Tobacco Co. Ltd accounted for 2,300,100 of the shares traded on Friday. Its price was unchanged at 135 cedis.
The largest gainer was Standard Chartered Bank (+250 cedis to 5,000), followed by Enterprise Insurance Company (+30 cedis to 460) and Unilever Ghana Ltd (+5 to 765).
Accra Brewery Company Ltd (-1 to 590) was the only declining issue.
The bourse has been dogged by negative sentiment with trading further depressed by concern over the impact of uncertain world gold prices on Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd, the market heavyweight.
The Index stood at 357.94 points on the previous Friday.
